items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 78:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the bowing of the head downward? The descent of the mouth of AA from its place, which is in the mouth of Atik, to the mouth of his KHB, in order to couple and give Mochin to Aba and Ima standing there, is discerned as the bowing of the head downward. See above in Answer 72 and below. (Item 193).
